record.edic_text:
1470 ekgrupto {eng-kroop'-to}

from 1722 and 2928;; v

AV - hide in 2; 2

1) to conceal in something
2) to mingle one thing with another

same.cexp: 秘密的，隱藏的；私人的；內在的
躲，隱藏，遮蓋（＜被＞躲起來）；保持秘密
